review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–131) but did not open the Mathlib sources. It is a test file. Its definitions are fixtures built on the project's own Berarducci/PrincipalSubring API and on Mathlib's DirectSum.of. They are idealGEApproachZeroLayer, idealGEApproachZeroElement, idealGEApproachZeroSquare, idealGEApproachZeroSquareElement and idealGEScalarPlusApproachZero. The last one is just `1 + idealGEApproachZeroElement`. None of them introduces a new concept that competes with something in Mathlib, Batteries or core. The theorems are ordinary test lemmas, and standalone theorem duplication is outside this rubric. I found nothing to report. The one remaining uncertainty is that I did not check whether the project's own PrincipalComponent or principalIdealGE definitions, which live in other files, duplicate Mathlib. That would be outside this file anyway.
